en: The postcard features a sepia-toned photograph of a quiet, tree-lined street with wooden buildings on each side, and a horse-drawn carriage in the distance. The street is labeled at the top as 'Sundsvall, Fredsgatan.' The reverse side shows handwritten Swedish text, a green Swedish stamp valued at 10 öre, and the address to a recipient in Holmundi. The publisher stamp says 'Svenska Fotografiska AB, Stockholm.'
